notes.title: Would you like to see this game worked on?
notes.content:

Yes, I lost hope for the game, kind of mostly because I am alone in this project and I don't have any faith or hope in someone actually enjoying this game. Before the Creative mode update, I still didn't have any motivation, its just that I wanted to present this game at the event that took place last year, but the good news is that recently due to some personal things in life, I got a little motivation to keep on updating this game. notes.title: Creative Mode, QoL Changes, Bug Fixes and more!
notes.content:
[h1]What is happening and why weren't there any new updates for the past month?[/h1]
It took me some time and motivation for me to start working on a new update. I personally tried to do a new things for example the story mode, but still couldn't figure it out, so as I decided I think that the story mode is cancelled, but as a return I have made the level editor.

[h1]Creative Mode[/h1]

With this update we bring you the [b]Creative Mode[/b]. This mode is something like a level editor. There are multiple buildables that you can choose from each one of them has its own abilities. Also with the Creative Mode we bring you the save/load system that allows you to save your world.

[h1]So... how does it work?[/h1]
[h2]Player Start[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647827/f2ff38213614293e0c3f828d3fcea8d6a1d47f39.png[/img]
There is a green cylinder that shows where the player start is. Don't be shocked when your screen is green once you enter the level.
[h2]Build Mode[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647827/5065e9ba656d6b8b53f17f8a74897dcf3ef0fdac.png[/img]
Press B on your keyboard to see a preview of where your buildable is going to be. Press B again to disable the preview. (NOTE: You can't build if you have not enabled the preview.)
[h2]Choose Buildable Menu[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647827/b78b1c83631518609e7cb21b9846291c49d15a6f.png[/img]
Currently there are only 4 buildables in the game.
They are as on the list:
[list]
[*]Lava ground block - Block with the Lava Level texture.
[*]Lava Block - Block with the Lava Texture - Once touched returns player to start.
[*]Prototype Block - Block with the grid texture on the baseplate.
[*]Finish Block - Block with the glowing white finish door texture - Once touched finishes level.
[/list]
To see the list of all buildables just press the TAB key on your keyboard.
[h2]Other stuff[/h2]
To remove any buildables, look at the buildable and hold right mouse button for 2 seconds. You will see an visual indicator. 
To save and load levels just go into the pause menu with ESC and press save or load depending on your need.
To play a level open the pause menu with ESC and click Play Level. (NOTE:If you don't save your level it will get erased once you play it. You can also save in while playing the level incase you forgot.)

[h1] New Menu Background Screen[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647827/7819e6b7739fcd016bad5bde42e9732568331c72.png[/img]
As you can see on the image, the background is different. You can notice how it is now moving and not in one place.

[h1] New music[/h1]
There is new music surrounding the main menu and Creative Mode maps. Credit to https://www.FesliyanStudios.com for the background music. 

[h1]TSA EoY Forum[/h1]
If you have been an participant or if you voted for the game in the TSA Forum I want to thank you for the support you have gave, and thanks to all the downloads that I got off of the event, it was very nice meeting you all and having some talks about the game!


And with this I wrap up today's update! Again thank you for all the support and please send any feedback or suggestions you might have in the Steam Hub of the game! I wish you all a fantastic day and have fun playing Minigames Master!

notes.title: Where we have been and what is happening?
notes.content:
Hello all players! In this announcement I have to say a few things about the game including a new story mode and developer breaks.

[h1]Story Mode[/h1]

Currently there is in plan a story mode and we are actively working on it. It will take a few weeks to release the first chapters, but they are going to come soon or later.


[h1]Developer Breaks[/h1]
This whole week we are going to stop development, but only for the week. 


[h1]In search of idea suggestors, 3D Modelers and Storyline Writers[/h1]
This is the part in which [b]YOU[/b] can participate in. If you have any interest in helping the game please send an email to:
"minigamesmasterinquries@gmail.com"

Your help can really make the game better!


This is the announcement, if you have any questions please ask in the discussions. Have a nice day!

notes.title: Air becomes bigger?
notes.content:
[h1]Introduction[/h1]

Welcome to the second major update! With this update we bring you new additions to the air level + some interesting UI changes which we hope makes your experience better! Let's get into them!


[h1]Air map[/h1]
The air map got new obstacles. They are easy to understand, but make the map longer!

[h2]The dive[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647827/00f165ab0525445f6f21506200754a6c17d2234c.png[/img]
In this obstacle you have to jump to the small platform and try not to fall.

[h2]The walkway[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647827/3fbdcd839ba7b2f96731b77248accc189b5b60cf.png[/img]
Here you have to walk down a simple path.

[h2]The path[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647827/5d35781d01a7ff864b174db7f2bf843484d5460c.png[/img]
Similarly to the lava level, here you have to choose the correct path.

[h1]UI Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647827/0b6cee6447ed194d486fbdac7e34f42b6d006278.png[/img]
We changed the font of all the menu's and beveled the edges. To make it even better we added a click sound to all the buttons.

[h1]QoL Changes[/h1]
In the start of the game, there is a short splash screen which can be skipped. We also made it easier to move while in air.

[h1]Release state and other important information[/h1]
We decided to make the release date public. The game will be released on the 3rd of March 2023. We really hope for you to support us by wishlisting the game and getting it on release. Did we mention that the game is going to be free? So we don't see any reason why not to wishlist the game and help us! We also made a developer board so you can track future updates and see what we are doing. You can see it by using [url=https://app.featuremap.co/mp/rAnVMQ/minigames-master]this link[/url].

Thank you very much for the support and the 25+ wishlists! We wish you a good day!

notes.title: Extension to the lava level
notes.content:
[h1]Lava map extension[/h1]

The first major update. How exciting! This update brings a level extension to the map "Lava". It has more obstacles that make it harder. Lets see what they are!

[h2]Choose the right path![/h2]
In this obstacle you have to choose the right path! Two fall to the lava and one brings you to the next obstacle. Choose carefully...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647827/629e9724f7ae7e9c6b8f2eddf50bd0cf5ad86f80.png[/img]

[h2] Moving Platform [/h2]
Try to jump at the perfect moment to catch the platform or you can accidentally fall into the lava.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43647827/0f35009bcbb0b516ff3cb313bd98e81c7c7d054a.png[/img]



[h1]Release state[/h1]
The game still requires some time so I can release it, but for know the plan is for the game to stay until march as in progress. If you want to get the chance to get the game early you can follow me on social media so you can find a giveaway!



I hope you like this update and still keep following the game's progress!
